title: Grateful Dead Live at Carousel Ballroom on 1968-03-31
lineage: AUD > MR > D > PCM > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard recording captures a solid late‑Anthem show highlighted by a beautiful “Feedback” segment
ai_review.review: The tape offers surprisingly pristine audio that sounds more like a studio feed than an audience capture, letting listeners enjoy a well‑executed stretch of the Anthem of the Sun material—especially the standout “Feedback.” While reviewers note the performance isn’t a legendary Good Night, it’s consistently praised as a very good show from the March 31 1968 run.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑star ratings and comment on excellent clarity and solid performance; a few lower or off‑topic scores keep confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audio is described as unusually clear and crisp, sounding too clean for an audience source; no dropout or muffling issues reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A fragment from the final Anthem of the Sun shows, delivering a strong, cohesive segment that closes the six‑month studio/performance period.
